A clean electric guitar plays rhythmic, muted scratches and staccato chords. The drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and tight hi-hat patterns. A second electric guitar provides melodic fills with a slight overdrive and wah-wah filter effect. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of E minor. The structure alternates between a bass-driven groove and sections where the guitars become more melodic and layered.

The kick drum executes a double-hit pattern on the first beat of every second measure, while the snare provides a crisp backbeat with occasional ghost notes. A dry, room-reverb profile characterizes the mix, with no additional instrumentation or melodic elements present. The recording maintains a consistent dynamic level throughout the loop.
